name: Protected object reader acceptance
scope: One Linux node: real local TLS object publication and contained DuckDB queries with deterministic Arrow refresh input.

verification.static_review: source and helpers independently hash pinned

limitations: Live S3, R2, Azure Blob and GCS provider certification remains blocked pending fixtures.
No throughput, production capacity, whole-node memory or deployment claim.
Full protected HTTP/gateway/export protocol acceptance is a separate gate; executor custody is covered.
Acceptance enters through Go test binaries and launches actual built CLI worker children; full node/gateway startup is not established.
Parent dependencies fence unit stop/inactivity. RemainAfterExit can retain active/exited after a clean driver exit; immediate process-loss coupling is not established.
The delegated sibling has its own 600-second runtime cap and independent cleanup; outer caps do not contain its resource use.
Outer bridge inputs are independently inventoried at collection. Child bridge inputs have source-runner before/after attestation; collection does not rehash that second bridge.
Workspace usage is a sampled logical byte count, not an atomic scan or filesystem quota; shared caches and unlinked open files are excluded.
Kernel test charged-memory observations are fixture cgroup measurements, not query memory or parent RSS.

required_coverage.regular_protected_skip: intentional; protected root runs in the separate delegated containment stage
